reason: I already take Toplux and just reorder it when it runs out, and at $31k a year I'm not paying $30 for something new. Foil sachets every day also feels like a lot of trash for a capsule I could take from a bottle.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and $29.99 is more than I pay for what I already take. My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, not that I need a fancy brand.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 a month, or a free trial box, plus a bottle option with no foil sachets.
